<Activity x:Class="ポップアップを閉じる" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities" xmlns:s="clr-namespace:System;assembly=System.Private.CoreLib" xmlns:uix="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities/uix" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <uix:NClosePopup PopupException="{x:Null}" PopupHandled="{x:Null}" DisplayName="ポップアップを閉じる" Version="V5">
    <uix:NClosePopup.PreferredButtons>
      <InArgument x:TypeArguments="s:String[]">
        <CSharpValue x:TypeArguments="s:String[]">new string[]{"Close", "Cancel"}</CSharpValue>
      </InArgument>
    </uix:NClosePopup.PreferredButtons>
  </uix:NClosePopup>
</Activity>
